# Root shim so a fresh clone works with the canonical:
#   python -m venv .venv
#   pip install -r requirements.txt
# The real dependency set lives in backend/:
#   backend/requirements.in   -- editable direct deps (source of truth)
#   backend/requirements.txt  -- pip-compile lockfile (generated; do not edit)
# See README "Running the Backend Without Docker (venv)" for the full setup.
-r backend/requirements.txt
